[[Frostbite (enchantment)|Frostbite]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Frostbite (enchantment)|Frostbite]]:''' On Hit: Applies a stack of [[Vulnerable]] (1% more damage for 3 seconds. This effect stacks up to 20 times, and loses one stack on expiration.). This effect may only occur on-hit once every two seconds.
On Vorpal: Applies a stack of [[Lethargy]] (-1 to all Saving Throws. Non-bosses also move and attack 5% slower. This effect stacks up to 5 times.)
